note: Hong Kong, read on the Immigration Department's own pages (read 2026-10-30): the General Employment Policy, the fee tables under the Immigration Regulations (Cap. 115A) and the right of abode. A professional with a job offer (a performer among them) is admitted under the GEP, a specified scheme, normally for an initial 36 months on employment condition or the contract's length, whichever is shorter, then extensions on the 3-2 year pattern; on employment condition the holder takes only the employment the Director approves (work for the sponsor). An application normally takes four weeks. The fee kept is the sum the page sets for a stay over 180 days: the specified scheme's application fee, HK$600, and the visa's issuance fee, HK$1,300; an extension costs the same issuance fee again. A person not of Chinese nationality who has ordinarily resided in Hong Kong for a continuous period of not less than seven years and has taken it as his or her place of permanent residence may become a permanent resident with the right of abode; that status's terms and fee were not on the page read, so it is not kept as a route of its own. Hong Kong confers no nationality, so no route counts toward naturalisation.

sources.title: General Employment Policy, Immigration Department (read 2026-10-30)
sources.said: it normally takes four weeks upon receipt of all the required documents and the relevant application fee. ... Persons admitted as professionals under the GEP will normally be granted an initial stay of 36 months on employment condition, or in accordance with the duration of the employment contract (whichever is shorter), upon entry. ... Successful applicants will normally be granted an extension of stay following the 3-2 year pattern ... Professionals admitted under the GEP who are on employment condition shall only take such employment as approved by the Director of Immigration. ... Persons admitted under the GEP who have ordinarily resided in the HKSAR for a continuous period of not less than seven years may apply for the right of abode in the HKSAR in accordance with the law.

sources.title: Fee tables: Visas, Extension of Limit of Stay & Other Services, Immigration Department (read 2026-10-30)
sources.said: issued pursuant to an approved specified scheme ... if the relevant period is more than 180 days $ 1,300 ... Application fee for a specified scheme ... $ 600 ... “General Employment Policy”

sources.title: Eligibility for right of abode in the HKSAR, Immigration Department (read 2026-10-30)
sources.said: A person not of Chinese nationality who has entered Hong Kong with a valid travel document, has ordinarily resided in Hong Kong for a continuous period of not less than seven years and has taken Hong Kong as his/her place of permanent residence
